co2.title: CO₂ dashboard
co2.desc: Emissions from fuel measured by telemetry. The figure you disclose in customer tenders is produced here.
co2.esas_aciklama_TTW: Tailpipe CO₂ only (Scope 1). Fuel production and distribution NOT included. Continues today's numbers.
co2.esas_aciklama_WTW: Upstream (WTT) plus tailpipe (TTW). ISO 14083 / GLEC ask for this and the figure rises by roughly 23 % for diesel. Switching recomputes past periods too — CO₂ is stored nowhere, so no mixed-basis table can arise.
co2.migration_yok: Migration 089 has not been run: per-vehicle fuel type cannot be entered (everything counts as diesel) and basis/target cannot be stored. The dashboard still works.
co2.hedef_tuttu: On target — {fark} g/km below the {hedef} g/km target ({yuzde} %)
co2.hedef_asildi: Target exceeded — {fark} g/km above the {hedef} g/km target ({yuzde} %)
co2.sofor_bos: No driver breakdown could be produced for this range.
co2.musteri_bos: No completed trip with a customer in this range.
co2.musteri_aciklama: The customer row is not an ALLOCATION but a MEASUREMENT: the trip's measured distance (odometer window) × the vehicle's measured intensity. Trips without measurable distance are excluded and counted separately.
co2.metod_girdi: Input: fuel consumption measured from vehicle telemetry — NOT fuel receipts (fuel_entries).
co2.metod_esas_TTW: Basis TTW: tailpipe CO₂ (Scope 1), upstream excluded.
co2.metod_musteri: Customer breakdown: trip distance (odometer window) × vehicle intensity (g/km).
co2.metod_sofor: The driver breakdown uses SHIFT odometer kilometres; the fleet total uses the vehicle odometer span. The two sources can differ by a few percent and both are correct — a vehicle also moves outside shifts. The figures for disclosure are the fleet and customer rows.
co2.metod_olculemeyen: Vehicles whose consumption cannot be measured are EXCLUDED and are not counted as 0 kg; their plates are listed above.
co2.sebeke_aciklama: For electric vehicles the WTW emissions depend on grid intensity, which is country-specific. Until it is entered the CO₂ figure reads “not measured” — writing 0 would present the vehicle as zero-emission. Source: EEA, Greenhouse gas emission intensity of electricity generation.
co2.hedef_aciklama: The target is set as INTENSITY (g/km), not absolute kg: an absolute target is breached automatically as the fleet grows and tells nobody anything.
co2.yakit_yok_baslik: Fuel data could not be computed for this range
co2.yakit_yok_no_rpc: The fuel measurement function (migration 052) is missing in this installation.
co2.yakit_yok_no_data: There are no fuel level readings in the range.

help.rep_zone_duration: Duration = exit time − entry time. If the vehicle is still inside, no duration is shown ("—"): it has not been measured yet. If the device signal drops, the visit is closed at the last confirmed moment and the row is flagged "Signal lost" — the real duration may be longer.
help.rep_zone_table: Each row is one visit: it starts when the vehicle enters the zone and ends when it leaves. Driving past the zone does not count as a visit; the vehicle must stay inside continuously for at least the defined threshold (2 minutes by default).
help.rep_zone_summary: Total duration and number of visits per customer zone. Visits that are still running (not yet measured) are not included in the total.
help.page_dashboard: The live board for today: who is in the field, how much has been worked, how many parcels were delivered, what is urgent.
help.page_dashboard_nopkg: The live board for today: who is in the field, how much has been worked, what is urgent.
help.page_analiz: A per-driver summary of driving safety and idling waste. Individual events are on the Alarms page.
help.page_reports: The report centre. Each report answers a single question: fuel, speed, distance, performance.
help.page_trips: The assignment plan: which driver is assigned to which zone on which day. Assignments made here appear in the driver's panel.
help.page_zones: Zones drawn on the map. Depot zones determine when working time starts.
help.page_workers: Employee records: details, driving licence, PIN, vehicle assignment. Click a person to see their history.
help.page_expenses: Expense receipts entered by drivers: category, amount, photo. They are approved or corrected here.
help.page_fuel_entries: Manually entered fuel receipts. The automatic fuel measurement from the device is somewhere else — on Reports → Fuel.
help.anl_kpi_events: Total driving events recorded in the selected period. Go to the Alarms page to see them one by one.
help.anl_kpi_idle_hours: The total time vehicles spent stationary with the engine running. The engine burns fuel for nothing.
help.anl_kpi_idle_euro: The estimated monetary value of the fuel wasted while idling. Not an exact invoice — an indication of scale.
help.anl_kpi_drivers: The number of drivers who drove far enough in this period to be scored. Drivers with little distance are not listed.
help.alarms_tab_overview: A summary by event type: each box shows one alarm type and its count. Click to drill into the records.
help.alarms_tab_log: Individual alarm records: which vehicle, who, when, at what speed. Click a row to open it on the map.
help.alarms_trend: The day-by-day distribution of alarms; the dark part is critical events. The percentage compares with the previous period of the same length.
help.alarms_col_vehicle: The vehicle where the event happened and its driver. If the vehicle changed hands, older events are labelled with today's driver.
help.alarms_col_type: The alarm type. The colour shows importance: red is critical, yellow a warning, grey informational.
help.alarms_col_time: The date and time the event was recorded by the device (Vienna time).
help.alarms_col_speed: The speed at the moment of the event. Speed is meaningless for idling records, so it says 'idling' instead.
help.rep_fuel_tank: How many litres the vehicle's tank holds. Without it, L/100km cannot be calculated.
help.rep_fuel_avg: The average tank level in the selected period (%). It does not show consumption, but how full the vehicle generally runs.
help.rep_fuel_consumed: Fuel burned over the period: fuel taken on + the drop in the tank.
help.rep_fuel_km: The total kilometres the vehicle drove in this period. It is the difference between the odometer at the end and the start.
help.rep_fuel_samples: The number of fuel readings sent by the device. A high count indicates the data is reliable.
help.rep_fuel_l100: How many litres are burned per 100 kilometres — a fair measure for comparing vehicles. If it is unreliable, the reason is shown.
help.rep_fuel_refills: The number of refuellings found in the period and their litres. Detected from a sudden rise in the tank level.
help.rep_fuel_leak: The number of times the fuel level dropped while the vehicle was not moving. It can be a sign of a leak or theft.
help.rep_speed_violations: The number of speeding events recorded in the selected period. The limit comes from the setting on the device in the vehicle.
help.rep_speed_max: The highest speed measured in the period. It is a single momentary value, not an average.
help.rep_speed_per100: Speeding events per 100 kilometres. So that drivers with a lot of mileage and those with little can be compared fairly.
help.rep_dist_km: The total kilometres the vehicle drove in the selected period. Calculated from the device's odometer value; the driver does not enter km by hand.
help.rep_dist_kmday: Average kilometres per day: total km ÷ the number of days driven.
help.rep_perf_score: A score out of 100: 50% delivery success, 35% compliance with working-time rules, 15% activity.
help.rep_perf_shifts: The number of COMPLETED (closed) shifts in the period. Open shifts are not counted.
help.rep_perf_worked: The total time actually worked once breaks have been deducted.
help.rep_perf_km: The total kilometres driven in this period by the vehicles the driver used.
help.rep_perf_delivered: The number of parcels reported as delivered. This figure does not rise until the shift is closed.
help.rep_perf_events: The driver's number of driving events in the period (harsh braking, harsh cornering, speeding, long idling). Lower is better.
help.range_window: The date range is rolling: "Last 7 days" means 7 days back including today. It is not a calendar week or month.
help.ops_title: This row is today's live summary; it shows the team in the field and the parcel situation at a glance.
help.ops_drivers: The number of drivers whose shift is currently open. Those on a break are included.
help.ops_vehicles: The number of vehicles currently on the road.
help.ops_break: The number of drivers currently on a break.
help.ops_km: The total kilometres driven on shifts completed today.
help.ops_loaded: The total number of parcels loaded onto vehicles today.
help.ops_delivered: The total number of parcels delivered today.
help.ops_undelivered: The number of parcels that could not be delivered and came back. If it is high, the reason should be asked.
help.fleet: The current status distribution of the vehicles: on the road, on break, free, in maintenance.
help.attention: Things that need attention now: expiring licences, upcoming inspections, silent vehicles, long shifts, unpaid penalties.
help.performance: Ranks drivers by km, hours, deliveries and number of shifts. Tap a heading to change the sorting.
help.perf_score: A score out of 100: 50% delivery success, 35% compliance with working-time rules, 15% activity.
help.map: Shows the live position of the fleet's vehicles from their GPS devices on the map; it refreshes roughly every 30 seconds.
help.shifts_hours: The total working time of the shifts completed in the selected range (breaks deducted).
help.shifts_km: The total kilometres on shifts completed in the selected range.
help.shifts_active: The number of currently open shifts (the same as 'drivers in the field' above).

help.report_azg: A compliance report listing possible violations under the Austrian working time act (AZG).
help.col_end: The time the shift ended. Open shifts show 'Active' or 'On break'.
help.col_worked: The time actually worked once breaks are deducted.
help.col_break: The total break time during the shift (minutes).
help.col_km: The kilometres driven on the shift (end − start).
help.col_loaded: The number of parcels loaded onto the vehicle at the start of the day for delivery.
help.col_delivered: The number of parcels delivered by the end of the shift.
help.col_undelivered: The number of parcels that could not be delivered and came back.

help.drv_break: Starts and ends your break. Break time is deducted from your working time.
help.drv_packages: Enter the number of parcels you will deliver today. You can change it later.
help.drv_end: Ends your shift. You are only asked how many parcels you are bringing back.
help.drv_end_nopkg: Ends your shift. A summary screen appears and it closes once you confirm.
help.veh_list: All vehicles in the fleet and their current status.
help.veh_status: The vehicle's current status: on the road, on break, free or in maintenance.
help.veh_inspection: The vehicle's inspection (§57a) and insurance expiry dates; as a date approaches it is flagged on the attention list.
help.veh_route: Follow the vehicle's past routes step by step on the map.
help.veh_penalties: Traffic and parking fines issued to the vehicle. Unpaid penalties appear on the Attention / Action list in the admin panel.
help.ops_over_limit: The number of shifts today that exceed the legal daily working limit (12 hours, 10 at night). This is a real violation.
help.ops_break45: The number of shifts over 9 hours that therefore require a 45-minute break. Not a violation — a break reminder.
help.anl_top10: Each box ranks the employees producing the most events of that type. It changes with the selected date range.
help.anl_archive: Each driver's alarm count for each month. The date picker above does not affect this; the archive always shows every month.
help.anl_safety: A driving score from 0 to 100. Events become penalty points and are divided by the kilometres driven — so a driver who drives a lot is not punished for it.
help.anl_idle: The time the vehicle stood still with the engine running. The fuel and € values are estimates, not measurements.
help.rep_fuel_table: Consumption = fuel taken on + the drop in the tank. L/100km is only calculated when there is enough distance and consumption.
help.rep_speed_table: Violations are the speeding events reported by the device. "/100 km" compares heavy and light mileage fairly.
help.rep_distance_table: km is the difference between the vehicle's own odometer at the start and end of the period. If the reading is unreliable, no km is invented — it shows "—".
help.rep_perf_table: Shifts, time, km and deliveries come from the shift records; events come from the device in the vehicle.
help.alarms_page: Driving events reported by the device in the vehicle. The limits were relaxed on 22 July; a warning appears for any range crossing that date.
help.anl_col_score: The driver's driving score from 0 to 100. Higher is better.
help.anl_col_events: This driver's total number of driving events in the selected period.
help.anl_col_basis: What the score is calculated against: kilometres driven or days worked.
help.anl_col_trend: Has the score gone up or down compared with the previous period?
help.anl_col_idle_duration: How long in total the vehicle stood still with the engine running.
help.anl_col_idle_count: How many times the vehicle stood still for a long period with the engine running.
help.anl_col_idle_liters: The fuel estimated to have been burned while standing. An estimate, not a measurement.
help.anl_col_idle_euro: The estimated monetary value of the fuel burned for nothing.
help.ops_on_break: The number of drivers currently on a break.
help.ops_vehicles_delivering: The number of vehicles currently on the road delivering.
help.ops_km_today: The total kilometres driven on shifts closed today.
help.drv_summary: The summary of your shift. If it is correct, sign it; if something is wrong, tell your manager.
help.strip_in_field: The number of drivers who opened a shift TODAY (including those on a break) / total active drivers. Shifts left open from earlier days are NOT included — they are on a separate line and on the "Open since yesterday" tab of the board.
help.strip_not_started: The number of drivers who have not opened a shift today. Those on leave are not counted.
help.strip_closed: The number of drivers who have closed their shift today.
help.strip_silent: The number of vehicles that have not sent a position for 24 hours. It may be a device problem.
help.strip_loaded: The total number of parcels loaded onto vehicles today.
help.strip_carried_over: The number of shifts started on earlier days that are still not closed. Because automatic closing is switched off, these do not close by themselves.

mevzuat.title: Compliance — live
mevzuat.desc: Remaining legal time for drivers in the field. Warns BEFORE a breach; the retrospective AZG report is untouched.
mevzuat.kapali_baslik: The live compliance layer is disabled in this installation
mevzuat.kapali_govde: Migration 086 has not been run. The AZG report and the rest of the panel work normally.
mevzuat.takograf_yok_baslik: This screen does not guarantee legal compliance — it gives early warning
mevzuat.takograf_yok_govde: The fleet has no tachograph. WORKING TIME is measured (shift + recorded break) and that is exactly what AZG and ArbZG regulate. DRIVING TIME, by contrast, is ESTIMATED from movement data — it is not evidence in an inspection, and its margin of error is shown on every row.
mevzuat.set_aciklama_AT_AZG: Working-time axis. Daily cap 12 h (§ 9 Abs. 1), 10 h on days with night work (§ 14 Abs. 2). Break: over 6 h 30 min, over 9 h 45 min (§ 13c Abs. 1).
mevzuat.set_aciklama_DE_ARBZG: Working-time axis. § 3 ArbZG sets 8 hours per working day; up to 10 only if the 24-week average is kept. A single-day engine can therefore only treat 10 hours as a breach, not 8. Break: >6–9 h 30 min, >9 h 45 min (§ 4).
mevzuat.set_aciklama_EU_561: DRIVING-time axis — ESTIMATE. Scope (Art. 2): goods >3.5 t, passengers >9. Since 1 July 2026 also >2.5 t in international transport and cabotage. Purely national transport is out of scope. Where a tachograph is mandatory, the legal record comes from the device, not from here.
mevzuat.surus_tahmini_aciklama: Time with movement in the telemetry counts as driving. Measured: about a third of shift duration cannot be classified as either driving or stopped because the device goes silent. That band is shown on every row.
mevzuat.surus_kapali: The selected rule set works on driving time, but the estimate is disabled — no rule is being computed. You can enable it in the settings.
mevzuat.sahada_yok_govde: The live layer scans open shifts only; a closed shift belongs to the retrospective report.
mevzuat.belirsiz_aciklama: Time with no device signal — classifiable as neither driving nor stopped.
mevzuat.sebep_vardiya_bayat: shift open for more than 24 hours
mevzuat.kademe_aciklama: A warning is sent once the remaining time falls below these values. The narrowest tier defaults to 15 min — the smart tachograph's own standard, which warns a driver 15 minutes before 4.5 hours of driving. Each tier reaches a driver ONCE per day.
mevzuat.hata_kademe_sirasi: Tiers must narrow: early > approaching > final

retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: Status of the raw GPS trail, data categories and the manual deletion tool. The system never deletes automatically.
retention.migration_missing: Migration 090 has not been run — the layer is not installed yet. db/migrations/090_saklama_politikasi.sql
retention.days_hint: At least {min}, at most {max}. Default {def}. This number DELETES NOTHING.
retention.reason_placeholder: e.g. for delivery disputes under CMR Art. 32…
retention.blocked_ozet_eksik: Some months touched by the range have no summary; deletion cannot proceed without them.
retention.blocked_km_donmadi: Shift km verdicts in the range have not been frozen; this is required before deletion.
retention.blocked_omur_izi_yok: The device lifetime trail has not been written yet; deleting would lose the silent-vehicle warning.
retention.prep_done: Preparation advanced: {months} monthly summaries, {shifts} shifts frozen.
retention.no_auto_delete: The system never deletes data automatically. The nightly job only calculates and warns; the decision to delete, and when, belongs to the controller. Galzura is the processor.
retention.no_warning: No raw location data past the warning threshold.
retention.warning_line: {rows} rows of raw location data have passed your {days}-day warning threshold ({table}).
retention.anchor_unverified: The legal anchor for {country} is NOT YET VERIFIED — no figure is stated here on purpose.
retention.country_hint: Which country's legal anchor to look up (two letters, e.g. AT).
retention.categories_basis: A GPS trail is legally the personal data of the person driving, not of the vehicle. The vehicle belonging to the company does not change that; the deciding question is who was in the vehicle at the time.
retention.cat_locked: not deletable — the interface offers no option
retention.delete_desc: You choose the range. The row count is shown first; to delete you must enter a reason and type SIL into the box.
retention.nothing_deletable: No deletable raw table — all are legally required.
retention.ref_hint: The week or month containing the chosen day will be deleted.
retention.preview_result: {rows} rows would be deleted ({from} → {to}). Nothing has been deleted yet.
retention.delete_reason_placeholder: e.g. deleting the April 2026 raw trail at the customer's request…
retention.delete_reason_hint: At least {min} characters. Recorded in the audit trail.
retention.confirm_label: Type {word} in the box to confirm
retention.deleted: {rows} rows deleted and recorded in the audit trail.
retention.error_ulke_kodu: Country code must be two letters (e.g. AT)
retention.error_ters_aralik: The end must be after the start
retention.error_gelecek: The range cannot extend into the future
retention.error_cok_uzun: Range too long for a single deletion
retention.blocked_kategori_yasal: This data is legally required and cannot be deleted.
retention.blocked_onay_yanlis: SIL was not typed into the confirmation box.
retention.blocked_sebep_kisa: The reason for deletion is too short.

tacho.title: Tachograph archive
tacho.description: Your driver card and vehicle unit files are kept here; download them from here for roadside or office checks.
tacho.archive_promise: Uploaded files are kept here permanently and are never deleted. When an inspection asks for them, you can download the original from here — unchanged, exactly as you uploaded it.
tacho.migration_missing: Migration 091 has not been run — the archive is not installed yet. db/migrations/091_takograf.sql
tacho.service_down: The file reader is not responding right now. Uploading still works: your file is archived and its contents will be read later.
tacho.drop_hint: .ddd files only · {max} MB maximum · you can select several at once
tacho.seal_warning_strip: The signature on {count} files in this list could not be verified — do not use them for official checks.
tacho.seal_warning_single: The signature on this file could not be verified — do not use it for official checks.
tacho.parse_bekliyor_long: This file has not been read yet. It is in the archive and can be downloaded; its contents will be extracted once the reader is reachable again.
tacho.parse_basarisiz_long: The contents of this file could not be read. The file REMAINS in the archive and can be downloaded — it was not deleted. It can be retried after the reader is updated.
tacho.empty_body: Upload the .ddd files you downloaded from a driver card or from the vehicle unit. Uploaded files are kept here permanently.
tacho.no_activity_title: No activity records in this file
tacho.no_activity_body: The file was read but contains no driving, work or rest records. Some driver card downloads only contain events and faults.
tacho.events_hint: Device records such as card withdrawal, power interruption or overspeeding. Shown as recorded, without interpretation.
tacho.uploaded_unread: {name} was archived but could not be read. The file is kept and can be downloaded.
tacho.err_duplicate: {name} is already here — the same file is not stored twice
tacho.err_depo_yazilamadi: {name} could not be archived — nothing was saved
tacho.err_migration_091_yok: The archive is not installed yet
tacho.err_arsivden_okunamadi: File could not be read from the archive
